03-ui-ux-designer.latest_learning: 95.9% of top homepages failed WCAG audits in 2026 — worst rate on record — driven by AI-generated frontends skipping manual accessibility validation. WCAG 3.0 (March 2026) replaces A/AA/AAA pass/fail with 174 outcome-based requirements and partial-credit scoring. Every UX handoff must include explicit, testable accessibility gates: contrast ratios, keyboard navigation paths, ARIA roles, and WCAG 2.1 AA error-pattern requirements.
